changelog: Final Audit Fixes (F1-F7): Resolved Neon driver SQL identifier parameterization in backup/restore scripts and serverless /api/backup endpoint. Enforced strict image MIME type validation and size limits on avatars to prevent stored XSS, with nosniff and CSP headers in /api/photo. Fixed comment-stripping parser in migration runner. Eliminated user status enumeration in login API by verifying bcrypt hash prior to status checks, and elevated minimum password length to 8 characters. Protected payment history from silent erasure in update-payment action. Wired FeeRemindersPage to real announcements notification system. Removed redundant localStorage user caching.
